attendance_policy: Each student is expected to attend all classes and participate in all evaluation components.
makeup_policy: No make-up will be given for the quizzes, in-class sessions/tasks. However, for the mid-semester and the comprehensive exam, make-up will be conducted for valid reasons with supporting documents and prior permission.
